survivingClaim: For polynomial heat solutions with zero set symmetric under rho -> -conj rho: (i) no unitarily invariant norm of Gamma_-(t) is monotone in t (proved through the one-pair collision; between collisions by 50-digit witnesses, not interval-certified); (ii) the sum of Re p over right-half-plane zeros of D_t = F_t + alpha F_t' is continuous and strictly decreasing while positive for every alpha > 0 (proved; classical Dyson-law mechanism); (iii) a non-negative functional vanishing on axis configurations that is monotone along the flow is non-increasing, so it bounds t = 0 only by backward-heat values (proved); (iv) its derivative is the contour flux -(1/4)(1/2 pi i) oint M^2 (classical; verified to 3.6e-30).
obstruction: A functional that vanishes on the critical configuration and is monotone along the heat flow must decrease forward, so it only transports information from t < 0 (where the conclusion is false) to t = 0. Differentiating the Hankel data in t does not change row Q4: the prime side is causal for every twist (argued) and the difference is the residue sum over zeros.
controlsThatDefeat: backward heat: the functional is bounded only by values at t < 0 where the conclusion is false
DH-type and E_a-type configurations: no proved step fails for them
sign twists: prime-side flux zero for every twist (argued from Q4, not computed)
lesson: Reject combinations whose engine is a heat-monotone functional of the anticausal Hankel block or of zero configurations.
refereeNote: All PROVED steps re-derived; (ii) is over zeros of D_t counted with multiplicity, not poles of S_t.
